correctness.rationale: A uniform balanced b-partition has (n/b)_r ordered r-block selections, all fully contained in a k-set with probability (k)_(br)/(n)_(br). Finite binomial inversion gives the exact Markov transition kernel. Conditional covariance between different retained-block indicators is nonpositive, so Var(K_s|K_{s-1}=k)<=b E[K_s|k]. At scaling n p^(b^t)->lambda with fixed p,b, prior mean a_(t-1) ~n^(1-1/b) diverges; uniform product expansion, Chebyshev and t=O(loglog n) give K_(t-1)/a_(t-1)->1. Conditional fixed-order factorial moments at final step ->(lambda/b)^r, hence Poisson(lambda/b). Independently enumerated all 15 balanced pairings of n=6,b=2, verifying all factorial moments from k=4. Exact integer-depth subsequence restriction is essential.
